title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Ai Development Orchestrator em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote Type: Full-Time Reports to: CEO Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start: Immediate The Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;  the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;  the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites. Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;  the AI is the author.Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role. Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy. Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications. Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving. How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty. What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;  quality comes from you. To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil). Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. description:

This is a fully remote position, PJ contract and salary range is 28-35/hr USD. Required Skills & Experience - 5+ years in Technical Program Management, Program Management, or Delivery/Project Leadership in software/product environments. - Strong experience working with engineering teams (front-end, back-end, APIs, integrations) and translating requirements into execution plans. - Demonstrated ability to manage multiple parallel workstreams with dependencies, ambiguity, and shifting priorities. - Comfort operating in Agile delivery environments and facilitating common delivery ceremonies. - Strong ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders—written, verbal, and executive-ready status reporting. - Proven organizational skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability. Nice to Have Skills & Experience - CPG experience (Consumer Packaged Goods) or work supporting enterprise-scale commerce, marketing, or customer platforms. - Experience using GitHub for product/engineering workflows (issues, epics, project boards, milestones, release tracking). - AI workflow experience (automation, copilots/assistants, orchestration tools, or applied AI to improve delivery ops). - Experience supporting digital commerce capabilities (e.G., customer experience, product catalogs, order flows, promotions, personalization, content, analytics). - Familiarity with Elixir and/or React environments—enough to partner effectively with engineers, understand constraints, and anticipate delivery risks. Job Description The Digital Commerce team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to amplify product delivery and relieve a Product Manager who is currently balancing product discovery alongside multiple concurrent projects. This TPM will drive program execution across cross-functional teams—translating product intent into clear plans, predictable delivery, and measurable outcomes—while ensuring work is well-managed in GitHub (where our PM workflows now live). This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and operations—bringing structure, visibility, and momentum to complex initiatives, and enabling the PM to focus on customer and market discovery. - Own end-to-end program management for multiple digital commerce initiatives, from intake through delivery and rollout. - Build and maintain integrated plans (milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing, timeline) across product, engineering, data, QA, security, and partner teams. - Drive delivery rituals: standups, sprint/iteration planning support, backlog readiness, dependency reviews, status reporting, and go/no-go readiness. - Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders—ensuring alignment on scope, sequencing, tradeoffs, and “definition of done.” - Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and decisions;  escalate with context and options, not just problems. - Ensure clear communication across teams and leadership with concise updates and action-oriented readouts. - Help standardize how initiatives are tracked in GitHub (e.G., issues, epics, project boards, milestones), driving consistent hygiene and visibility. - Improve team throughput by reducing friction in processes and tooling (templates, workflows, reporting, intake). - Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled workflows to reduce overhead (e.G., release comms drafting, backlog grooming support, automated status summaries, incident triage workflows, documentation acceleration) while maintaining governance and quality. - Partner with engineering and product to implement pragmatic automation that improves delivery efficiency. - Coordinate release plans across teams: readiness checklists, rollout sequencing, communication plans, training/support readiness, and post-launch monitoring. - Ensure operational handoffs and documentation are complete for production support.

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.   Core Responsibilities:  Student Support & Intervention  Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.  Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.  Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.  Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.  Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.  Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.  Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.  Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.  Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.  Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.  Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.  Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.  Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.  Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.  Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.  Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.  Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.  Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.  Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.  Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.  Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).  Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.    Collaboration  Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.  Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.  Monitor students’ progress and well-being.  Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.  Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.  Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.  Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.  Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.  Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.  Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.    Operational and Professional Conduct  Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.  Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.  Maintain accurate student records.  Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.  Participate in professional development opportunities.  Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.  Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.  Follow the  EAC Safeguarding Guide.    Other duties, as assigned.   Working Conditions:  Walk on paths and rough terrain  May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up     POSITION REQUIREMENTS  Minimum Education Required:    BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent  Minimum Experience Required:  Five years of teaching experience, preferred  Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.  Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.   Specific Knowledge:  Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.  Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.  Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.   Other Skills (Desirable):  Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.  Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.  Collegial and collaborative.  Innovative and creative.  Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.   English level required:  C1 or above  Portuguese level required:  none for teachers instructing in English  C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese    Child Safeguarding  Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.    EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion  EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Empresa está contratando Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Job Overview:     The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.    Core Responsibilities:     Student Support & Intervention     Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.   Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.   Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.   Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.   Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.   Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.   Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.   Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.   Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.   Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.   Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.   Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.   Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.   Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.   Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.   Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.   Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.   Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.   Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.   Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.   Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).   Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.      Collaboration     Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.   Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.   Monitor students’ progress and well-being.   Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.   Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.   Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.   Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.   Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.   Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.   Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.      Operational and Professional Conduct     Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.   Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.   Maintain accurate student records.   Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.   Participate in professional development opportunities.   Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.   Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.   Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.      Other duties, as assigned.    Working Conditions:     Walk on paths and rough terrain   May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up      POSITION REQUIREMENTS     Minimum Education Required:     BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent   Minimum Experience Required:     Five years of teaching experience, preferred   Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.   Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.     Specific Knowledge:     Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.   Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.   Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.     Other Skills (Desirable):     Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.   Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.   Collegial and collaborative.   Innovative and creative.   Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.     English level required:     C1 or above   Portuguese level required:     none for teachers instructing in English   C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese    Child Safeguarding     Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.    EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion     EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Overview: The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students. Core Responsibilities: Student Support & Intervention Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support. Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator. Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies. Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward. Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities. Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills. Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning. Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered. Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans. Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success. Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies. Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans. Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding. Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles. Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required. Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family. Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration. Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator. Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments. Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children. Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs. Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers. Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented). Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge. Collaboration Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension. Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports. Monitor students’ progress and well-being. Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners. Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning. Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children. Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning. Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load. Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed. Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks. Operational and Professional Conduct Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies. Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress. Maintain accurate student records. Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods. Participate in professional development opportunities. Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned. Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines. Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide. Other duties, as assigned. Working Conditions: Walk on paths and rough terrain May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up POSITION REQUIREMENTS Minimum Education Required: BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent Minimum Experience Required: Five years of teaching experience, preferred Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences. Experience working in a school setting or educational environment. Specific Knowledge: Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners. Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented. Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards. Other Skills (Desirable): Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills. Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven. Collegial and collaborative. Innovative and creative. Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure. English level required: C1 or above Portuguese level required: none for teachers instructing in English C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese Child Safeguarding Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety. EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

A Aegea Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local. Programa Respeito dá o Tom O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança. A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças. Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características. Responsabilidades e Atribuições Desenvolver estudos tributários e societários complexos, com foco na identificação de oportunidades de eficiência fiscal e otimização de carga tributária. Identificar, mensurar e acompanhar incentivos e benefícios fiscais, garantindo correta aplicação e captura de valor para o negócio. Atuar na identificação, análise e gestão de riscos tributários, incluindo reporte estruturado e suporte à governança e mitigação. Apoiar a revisão e monitoramento do compliance tributário, incluindo validação de bases, recolhimentos, compensações e obrigações acessórias. Conduzir o acompanhamento do orçamento tributário (orçado x realizado), analisando desvios e propondo melhorias estruturais. Elaborar projeções tributárias e análises de impacto financeiro, incluindo cenários relacionados à Reforma Tributária. Apoiar projetos estratégicos (M&A, novos negócios e reestruturações), avaliando impactos fiscais e traduzindo temas técnicos para tomada de decisão. Requisitos e Qualificações Formação sólida em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas. Sólido conhecimento da legislação tributária (federal, estadual e municipal), incluindo apuração, créditos e compensações. Conhecimento relevante em tributos sobre lucro (IRPJ, CSLL e correlatos). Experiência com planejamento tributário e elaboração de estudos técnicos. Experiência em gestão de riscos tributários e suporte à governança. Vivência em orçamento tributário e acompanhamento (orçado x realizado), bem como projeções financeiras. Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Captain - Airbus A320
description:

Job Description Make the world your home. It's an extraordinary time to join Etihad. In 2025 alone we've carried over 10 million guests, announced 30+ new destinations, and recorded the strongest half-year profit in our history. With more than 20 new aircraft arriving this year and a clear path to double our fleet by 2030, we're investing heavily in the future and redefining what global aviation looks like.Just as we push boundaries for our guests through innovation, sustainability, and world-class service, we're equally committed to providing our pilots with exceptional careers. Etihad, ranked the world's safest airline, offers a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle for you and your family, complemented by tax-free salaries, concessionary travel, comprehensive benefits, and endless opportunities for progression inside and beyond the cockpit.What we offer Etihad provides a competitive, tax-free package designed to reward performance and support your lifestyle in Abu Dhabi. Your annual package includes basic salary, flying pay, housing allowance, and layover and meal allowances, with the potential to earn up to AED 674,029 (USD 181,589)  per year based on 75 flying hours per month. Your salary includes performance-based annual increments, complemented by a comprehensive range of benefits:Education allowance of up to AED 40,000 for primary and AED 55,000 for secondary per child, for up to three children Income protection scheme 42 days of annual leave Industry-leading staff travel benefits and access to Etihad's exclusive discounts End-of-service benefits Accidental and life insurance coverage Etihad supports candidates relocating to Abu Dhabi through initiatives such as a shipping container allowance, settling-in support, and family travel benefits from any location in the world   The Role As a Captain with Etihad, you hold ultimate authority for the safe, secure, and efficient operation of every flight. You are entrusted with technical command of the aircraft, leadership of the crew, and the responsibility to uphold Etihad's highest standards of professionalism.Ensure the safety and security of crew, passengers, cargo, and aircraft at all times Exercise full command of the aircraft from taxi-out to final engine shutdown Lead the flight and cabin crew, demonstrating strong decision-making and effective crew resource management Operate with efficiency and environmental responsibility, in line with company fuel and sustainability policies Deliver consistent On Time Performance to meet Etihad's commitment to reliability and guest satisfaction  What you'll bring To be considered for the role of Captain A320, you must meet the criteria below:A minimum of 5500 hours total flying time. A minimum of 2500 PIC hours on multi crew, glass cockpit (1)  A minimum of 1500 PIC hours on one of the A320 Family Flown A320 family within the last 12 months Type rating on A320 should be valid for a minimum of 2 months at the time of joining Unrestricted and current ICAO ATPL Current on A320 Unrestricted and current Class 1 medical Have not attained the age of 59 years on the day of joining Current TRE/TRI is an advantage English Language Fluency (written and verbal) Level 4 or higher In case of hours accumulated on flights with inflight relief, 75% of the total hours shall be counted towards the required minimum  (1) Glass Cockpit: aircraft with a FMS coupled to APFDSAdditional Information Etihad Airways is more than the UAE's national airline - we're shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, our pilots fly one of the world's most modern and efficient fleets, operating across six continents and connecting people and cultures every day. As we advance our "Journey 2030" ambition to double our fleet and expand our global network, we're creating unparalleled opportunities for pilots to grow, lead and fly at the highest level. Join us and take your career to new horizons with an airline built for the future.To learn more visit  Recruitment Fraud Alert  Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

title: Advogado
description:

Olá, futuro(a) ADVOGADO PLENO/SÊNIOR ✨  Somos uma empresa líder no setor de saúde, dedicada a fornecer soluções inovadoras que salvam vidas e melhoram a qualidade do atendimento a pacientes em todo o país. Buscamos um(a) Advogado(a) Pleno/Sênior estratégico e proativo para integrar nosso departamento jurídico interno, garantindo a segurança legal e o sucesso das nossas operações junto à Administração Pública e Hospitais particulares.  Resumo da Vaga  O(a) profissional será o(a) principal parceiro(a) jurídico(a) da área comercial no que tange ao mercado público. Terá atuação de destaque na análise e gestão de contratos administrativos, mitigação de riscos e elaboração de teses jurídicas para defender os interesses da empresa em certames licitatórios e processos cíveis.    Principais Responsabilidades  Elaboração de Peças: Redigir impugnações a editais, recursos administrativos, contrarrazões, pedidos de esclarecimento e representações junto à Administração Pública, Ministério Público e Tribunais de Contas. Gestão de Contratos Administrativos: Atuar na análise, negociação e gestão de contratos com o Poder Público, elaborando aditivos, pedidos de prorrogação e pleitos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro. Gestão de Contratos Particulares: Atuar na análise, negociação e gestão de contratos particulares, pedidos de prorrogação e pleitos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro. Consultoria Interna: Prestar suporte jurídico consultivo diário para as demais áreas internas da empresa. Atuação em processos cíveis diversos, elaborando peças processuais diversas e participando em audiências.  Compliance e Regulação:  Garantir que os contratos estejam em conformidade com as regras de compliance da empresa e com as normativas do setor de saúde.    Requisitos e Qualificações  Formação superior completa em Direito, com registro ativo na OAB. Experiência Sênior: Mínimo de 05 anos de experiência comprovada em Direito Administrativo, com foco majoritário em licitações e contratos. Domínio Legislativo: Conhecimento profundo da Nova Lei de Licitações (Lei nº 14.133/21), além da Lei nº 8.666/93, 10.520/02 e Lei das Estatais (Lei nº 13.303/16). Vivência no Setor de Saúde: Experiência prévia atuando com licitações no segmento médico, farmacêutico, hospitalar ou de Life Sciences. Habilidade de negociação, visão de negócios e capacidade de traduzir riscos jurídicos em orientações práticas para lideranças não jurídicas. Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal.  ⭐ Diferenciais  Pós-graduação ou Especialização em Direito Administrativo, Direito Público ou Direito Médico. Conhecimento das normas de Compliance na relação público-privada (Lei Anticorrupção - Lei nº 12.846/13).   O que oferecemos:  Salário: Enviar pretensão salarial Jornada: Segunda a Sexta Horário: 08h às 17h Local de trabalho: SKY Galleria (Campinas/SP) Regime de trabalho: HÍBRIDO (seguindo os critérios da política interna) Regime de contratação: CLT Plano de carreira Cesta básica: R$ 250,00 Vale refeição: Total de R$ 32,00/dia Vale transporte: C/ desconto 6% ou Auxílio combustível fixo de R$ 300,00 Cartão Flexível: Benefícios pagos via Sólides (Mastercard) Convênio Farmácia: Crédito de R$ 300,00 com desconto em folha Confraternizações: Coffee Break na última quarta-feira do mês Parcerias Educacionais: Instituição de Ensino Anhanguera/Grupo Cogna Convênios: Médico e odontológico (após período de experiência). This role requires excellent communication skills and a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining composure and professionalism. A strong understanding of business needs is essential, along with the ability to contribute to a team dedicated to solving complex customer challenges. description:

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Ai Operations Manager
description:

About Our Client Our client is an AI-led operating system for the drayage industry. They power trucking companies that move containers in and out of the ports, a mission-critical often overlooked corner of the supply chain. Drayage is a fragmented, relationship-heavy market with over 80% of carriers running fewer than 20 trucks, and they don't respond to mass-blast outbound. Winning here requires a GTM motion that's smarter, more researched, and more personalized than the rest of freight tech. That's where this role comes in. The Role We're hiring our first dedicated GTM Engineer to sit at the intersection of sales, marketing, and product. You'll build the systems, workflows, and AI-powered tooling that let a focused revenue team generate an enterprise-grade pipeline without enterprise-grade headcount. If you've ever looked at a sales motion and thought\ "this could be 10x more efficient with the right stack, the right data, and a few well-placed LLM calls\ " this is the role for you. You'll have the rare combination of a real ICP (drayage carriers and brokers), a rich domain (FMCSA data, port operations, chassis pools, intermodal flows), and autonomy to build. What You'll Own Outbound & Account Intelligence Build and maintain enrichment pipelines that combine FMCSA SAFER data, port activity signals, fleet composition, chassis ownership, terminal proximity, and TMS incumbency to score and prioritize drayage carriers and brokers Develop LLM-powered personalization workflows in Clay, Apollo, or similar so every outbound touch references the prospect's actual operating reality, not a generic\ "growing your trucking business\ " pitch Stand up intent-data and remarketing reconciliation flows across our tech stack Sales Enablement & Pre-Call Intelligence Productize pre-call intel briefs into automated, repeatable artifacts AEs can pull on demand Build and maintain competitive battlecards and displacement playbooks for our most common takeouts (CompCare/Compcare, Profit Tools, Trinium, McLeod, Tailwind, in-house systems) Call Intelligence & Revenue Analytics Build pipelines from Gong (or successor) into LLM workflows that produce daily/weekly sales reports, surface objection patterns, flag at-risk deals, and feed competitive intel back to product and marketing Partner with RevOps to build attribution, conversion, and velocity dashboards that actually inform decisions not just decorate Monday meetings Field & Event Activation Build the systems behind PortFest, Drive, TPM and regional drayage association events: pre-event prospect lists, post-event nurture flows, on-site demo capture, attribution back to pipeline Help marketing run experiments on messaging, positioning, and channel mix and instrument them properly so we learn from what works Internal AI Tooling Stand up and govern internal AI workflows the GTM team uses daily: prompt libraries, custom Claude/GPT projects, RAG over our content library, MCP integrations with our CRM and call platforms Be the person who decides when a workflow should be a Clay table vs. a Python script vs. a real product request to engineering What We're Looking For Required 3+ years in a GTM Engineering, RevOps, Sales Engineering, or Growth Engineering role and a bonus if any of that was at a vertical B2B SaaS company Working proficiency in Python and SQL;  comfortable in JavaScript when needed Deep, opinionated fluency with the modern GTM stack: Clay, Apollo (or similar), Gong, Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) prompt design, tool use, evals, cost management A track record of shipping systems that demonstrably moved a revenue metric: pipeline created, meetings booked, win rate, cycle time Strongly Preferred Domain knowledge in freight, logistics, supply chain, or trucking or proven ability to ramp on a complex vertical fast Familiarity with FMCSA data sources (SAFER, L&I, MCS-150), or analogous public/regulatory datasets in another vertical Experience with MCP, agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.), or production AI Orchestration You'll thrive here if you Get genuinely curious about the operational details of how a drayage carrier makes money: chassis splits, per diem, demurrage, accessorials, the difference between asset-based and brokerage authority Default to building rather than briefing;  You'd rather ship a v1in a week than write a 20-page requirements doc Treat AEs and CSMs as your customers;  their adoption of whatyou build is the measure of whether it worked- Are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows how a particular system actually works, and write things down so that changes What Success Looks Like By 90 days: Pre-call intel briefs and account enrichment are running on automation for the AE team;  outbound personalization quality is measurably higher By 6 months: Pipeline created per SDR/AE has meaningfully increased through better targeting and tooling By 12 months: PortPro's GTM stack is a competitive advantage and visiting peers from other freight tech companies leave wanting what we have

title: Consultor(A) Comercial
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Consultor(A) Comercial em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Junte-se à Robert Half e transforme carreiras e negócios.   Na Robert Half, estamos em constante evolução e buscamos Consultores(as) Comerciais com perfil consultivo, capazes de atuar em vendas complexas, de alto valor agregado , conectando desafios estratégicos de clientes às melhores soluções em talentos.  Quem somos e o que fazemos   Nossa missão é impactar vidas e organizações, apoiando empresas na tomada de decisões críticas relacionadas a pessoas e crescimento, por meio de soluções especializadas em recrutamento, projetos e consultoria em talentos . Atuamos de forma próxima aos clientes, entendendo profundamente seus contextos de negócio, desafios e objetivos de longo prazo.  Oferecemos um ambiente inclusivo, dinâmico e orientado a performance, com forte investimento em desenvolvimento profissional, tecnologia e inteligência de mercado.  O que oferecemos   Remuneração competitiva e pacote de benefícios atrativo;  Modelo de trabalho híbrido;  Cultura orientada a bem-estar, performance sustentável e desenvolvimento contínuo;  Programas estruturados de treinamento em vendas consultivas e liderança;  Investimento constante em tecnologia e inteligência artificial para apoiar decisões comerciais;  Programas globais de reconhecimento e incentivo;  Oportunidades reais de mobilidade e crescimento no Brasil e no exterior.   Suas responsabilidades   Como Consultor(a) Comercial, sua atuação será fortemente estratégica e consultiva, com foco em desenvolver negócios, estruturar soluções customizadas e construir parcerias de longo prazo . Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:  Prospecção ativa e desenvolvimento de novos clientes, com foco em vendas complexas e consultivas ;  Gestão de contas estratégicas e relacionamento com decisores e lideranças de diferentes níveis;  Diagnóstico profundo das necessidades dos clientes, traduzindo desafios de negócio em soluções de recrutamento e talentos;  Condução de negociações comerciais e gestão de contratos, considerando ciclos de venda mais longos e múltiplos stakeholders;  Atuação integrada com times de recrutamento, participando do desenho da estratégia de busca como diferencial da proposta de valor;  Acompanhamento do processo de contratação e garantia da entrega de valor ao cliente;  Análise de mercado, tendências e mapeamento competitivo para apoiar decisões comerciais;  Visitas a clientes e participação ativa em reuniões estratégicas.    Quem procuramos   Buscamos profissionais com perfil consultivo, visão de negócio e alta capacidade relacional, que tenham:  Experiência prévia em vendas B2B complexas ou consultivas;  Capacidade de atuar com múltiplos stakeholders e influenciar decisores;  Forte orientação a resultados, sem abrir mão de ética e qualidade na entrega;  Habilidade paraconstruir relações de confiança de longo prazo com clientes e candidatos;  Experiência prévia ou atuação próxima a processos de recrutamento e seleção será considerada um diferencial, mas não é um requisito obrigatório. Pensamento analítico, curiosidade intelectual e capacidade de entender diferentes modelos de negócio;  Boa comunicação, presença executiva e habilidade de negociação;  Graduação completa;  Inglês avançado.   Nosso compromisso com a diversidade   Na Robert Half, acreditamos que diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e histórias fortalece nossos resultados. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e equitativo, onde cada pessoa pode ser quem é e atingir seu máximo potencial.  Faça parte da nossa história   Se você busca uma posição comercial estratégica, com impacto real nos negócios dos clientes e na carreira das pessoas, venha construir o futuro com a Robert Half.

title: Manufacturing Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Manufacturing Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for an experienced Manufacturing Manager to lead our FMCG production operations in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. This role is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and cost-effective manufacturing while maintaining the highest standards of quality, compliance, and service. The ideal candidate will bring more than 10 years of manufacturing leadership experience, including strong exposure to multinational company environments.  Key Responsibilities Lead day-to-day manufacturing operations to achieve production, quality, safety, and cost targets. Develop and implement production plans to meet customer demand and business objectives. Drive operational excellence through continuous improvement, lean manufacturing, and waste reduction initiatives. Ensure full compliance with health, safety, environmental, and quality standards. Monitor plant performance through KPIs and take corrective action to improve efficiency, output, and reliability. Manage and develop operations teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to build a high-performance culture. Oversee budget control, labour productivity, inventory optimisation, and cost management across the manufacturing function. Support capital projects, process improvements, and equipment upgrades to enhance manufacturing capability. Promote strong people leadership, coaching, succession planning, and employee engagement across the site.   Candidate Profile Minimum 10 years of manufacturing experience, with significant leadership responsibility in the FMCG industry. Proven experience working within a multinational company environment. Strong knowledge of production planning, quality systems, health and safety, and continuous improvement methodologies. Demonstrated ability to lead teams in a high-volume, fast-moving manufacturing setting. Experience managing KPIs, budgets, cost control, and operational performance. Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, or a related discipline preferred. Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement certifications would be an advantage.

title: Gestor De Negócios Ii | Diagnóstico Ivd
description:
Empresa está contratando Gestor De Negócios Ii | Diagnóstico Ivd em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

VIVEO - Cuidar de cada vida, simples assim!      Fundados em 1996, somos líderes na fabricação e na distribuição de materiais e medicamentos para o segmento da saúde, com produtos e soluções para todo o Brasil. Com capital 100% nacional, com mais de 50 unidades operacionais e centros de distribuição em todas as regiões do país, temos nossa própria frota e contamos com mais de 6.500 colaboradores diretos.    Com o propósito de cuidar de cada vida, somos a única empresa do Brasil que atua de forma completa no mercado da saúde. Essa atuação reforça nosso compromisso em oferecer soluções confiáveis, ágeis e inovadoras ao setor – incluindo fabricação, distribuição, gestão de estoque, transporte e soluções personalizadas aos hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, farmácias, atacados, indústrias farmacêuticas e aos pacientes finais. Buscamos encontrar e viabilizar as inovações que definirão como cuidar das pessoas do amanhã.    Atividades:   Buscamos um profissional com perfil estratégico e comercial para atuar na gestão e desenvolvimento de uma carteira regional de laboratórios clínicos, com foco no mercado de diagnóstico in vitro (IVD). Será responsável por fortalecer relacionamentos com contas estratégicas, identificar oportunidades de expansão, analisar mercado e concorrência, conduzir negociações e ampliar a participação da empresa nas contas existentes. A atuação será na região de Campinas e arredores, com rotina externa, visitas a clientes e interface com áreas internas para garantir execução, crescimento e geração de valor ao negócio.    Responsabilidades e atribuições:     -  Administrar e desenvolver contas estratégicas, com atuação próxima aos clientes da carteira regional, buscando relacionamento de longo prazo e expansão de negócios;    -  Identificar oportunidades de novos negócios por meio de mapeamento de mercado, levantamento de demandas, análise do potencial das contas e prospecção estruturada;    -  Atuar de formaconsultiva junto a laboratórios clínicos, compreendendo suas rotinas, necessidades operacionais e desafios, para propor soluções aderentes ao portfólio da empresa;    -  Analisar concorrência, tendências e condições de mercado, gerando inteligência comercial para apoiar o posicionamento dos produtos e a tomada de decisão;    -  Aumentar market share nas contas existentes, promovendo expansão de portfólio, fidelização de clientes e desenvolvimento de novas frentes comerciais;    -  Elaborar e conduzir planos de ação por conta e por território, com foco em metas, rentabilidade, potencial de crescimento e cobertura de mercado;    -  Construir relacionamento com decisores e influenciadores das contas, incluindo áreas técnicas, administrativas, suprimentos e liderança dos laboratórios;    -  Conduzir negociações comerciais, acompanhando propostas, condições comerciais, prazos, follow-ups e fechamento de oportunidades;    -  Acompanhar o ciclo de vendas de ponta a ponta, desde a prospecção e qualificação até implantação, pós-venda e monitoramento de resultados;    -  Atuar de formaintegrada com áreas internas como marketing, produto, aplicação, suporte e operações, assegurando alinhamento entre estratégia comercial e entrega ao cliente;    -  Monitorar indicadores de desempenho da carteira, pipeline, conversão, participação de mercado e evolução das contas;    -  Cumprir agendade visitas, rotas e demandas comerciais dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, com atuação externa frequente na região designada.    Requisitos:     -  Graduação completa;    -  Vivência no segmento de diagnóstico clínico IVD, preferencialmente com relacionamento junto a laboratórios clínicos;    -  Experiência emgestão de contas, prospecção e desenvolvimento de negócios;    -  Conhecimento em análise de mercado, concorrência e planejamento comercial;    -  Habilidade para negociação, relacionamento com clientes e condução de vendas consultivas;    -  Domínio do Pacote Office;    -  CNH categoria B;    -  Disponibilidade para viagens;    -  Residir em Campinas ou arredores;     Diferenciais     -  Experiência prévia com carteira de laboratórios clínicos;    -  Conhecimento do mercado de diagnóstico in vitro (IVD) e suas dinâmicas comerciais;    -  Vivência com contas estratégicas e expansão regional de mercado;    -  Familiaridade com CRM, gestão de funil e indicadores comerciais.

title: Food Safety Manager
description:

A posição requer um perfil técnico sólido aliado à capacidade de liderança e execução no dia a dia. Quem somos e o que fazemos      Nossa missão é impactar vidas e organizações, apoiando empresas na tomada de decisões críticas relacionadas a pessoas e crescimento, por meio de  soluções especializadas em recrutamento, projetos e consultoria em talentos  . Oferecemos um ambiente inclusivo, dinâmico e orientado a performance, com forte investimento em desenvolvimento profissional, tecnologia e inteligência de mercado. title: Manufacturing Manager

We are looking for an experienced Manufacturing Manager to lead our FMCG production operations in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. This role is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and cost-effective manufacturing while maintaining the highest standards of quality, compliance, and service. The ideal candidate will bring more than 10 years of manufacturing leadership experience, including strong exposure to multinational company environments. Manage and develop operations teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to build a high-performance culture. Demonstrated ability to lead teams in a high-volume, fast-moving manufacturing setting.   Experience managing KPIs, budgets, cost control, and operational performance.   Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills.   Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, or a related discipline preferred.   Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement certifications would be an advantage.

title: Airbus A320 Captain | Relocation To Abu Dhabi
description:

Job Description Make the world your home. It's an extraordinary time to join Etihad. In 2025 alone we've carried over 10 million guests, announced 30+ new destinations, and recorded the strongest half-year profit in our history. With more than 20 new aircraft arriving this year and a clear path to double our fleet by 2030, we're investing heavily in the future and redefining what global aviation looks like. Just as we push boundaries for our guests through innovation, sustainability, and world-class service, we're equally committed to providing our pilots with exceptional careers. Etihad, ranked the world's safest airline, offers a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle for you and your family, complemented by tax-free salaries, concessionary travel, comprehensive benefits, and endless opportunities for progression inside and beyond the cockpit. What we offer Etihad provides a competitive, tax-free package designed to reward performance and support your lifestyle in Abu Dhabi. Your annual package includes basic salary, flying pay, housing allowance, and layover and meal allowances, with the potential to earn up to AED 674,029 (USD 181,589) per year based on 75 flying hours per month. Your salary includes performance-based annual increments, complemented by a comprehensive range of benefits: Education allowance of up to AED 40,000 for primary and AED 55,000 for secondary per child, for up to three children Income protection scheme 42 days of annual leave Industry-leading staff travel benefits and access to Etihad's exclusive discounts End-of-service benefits Accidental and life insurance coverage Etihad supports candidates relocating to Abu Dhabi through initiatives such as a shipping container allowance, settling-in support, and family travel benefits from any location in the world The Role As a Captain with Etihad, you hold ultimate authority for the safe, secure, and efficient operation of every flight. You are entrusted with technical command of the aircraft, leadership of the crew, and the responsibility to uphold Etihad's highest standards of professionalism. Ensure the safety and security of crew, passengers, cargo, and aircraft at all times Exercise full command of the aircraft from taxi-out to final engine shutdown Lead the flight and cabin crew, demonstrating strong decision-making and effective crew resource management Operate with efficiency and environmental responsibility, in line with company fuel and sustainability policies Deliver consistent On Time Performance to meet Etihad's commitment to reliability and guest satisfaction What you'll bring To be considered for the role of Captain A320, you must meet the criteria below: A minimum of 5500 hours total flying time. A minimum of 2500 PIC hours on multi crew, glass cockpit (1) A minimum of 1500 PIC hours on one of the A320 Family Flown A320 family within the last 12 months Type rating on A320 should be valid for a minimum of 2 months at the time of joining Unrestricted and current ICAO ATPL Current on A320 Unrestricted and current Class 1 medical Have not attained the age of 59 years on the day of joining Current TRE/TRI is an advantage English Language Fluency (written and verbal) Level 4 or higher In case of hours accumulated on flights with inflight relief, 75% of the total hours shall be counted towards the required minimum (1) Glass Cockpit: aircraft with a FMS coupled to APFDS Additional Information Etihad Airways is more than the UAE's national airline - we're shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, our pilots fly one of the world's most modern and efficient fleets, operating across six continents and connecting people and cultures every day. As we advance our "Journey 2030" ambition to double our fleet and expand our global network, we're creating unparalleled opportunities for pilots to grow, lead and fly at the highest level. Join us and take your career to new horizons with an airline built for the future. To learn more visit Recruitment Fraud Alert Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.
